call_purpose: You called about offering monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page, sending customers to your own thank-you page after purchase, and adding GST to your prices.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout page.

Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option and saved it, and you confirmed with a test purchase that it took you straight to your thank-you page.

covered.text: We explained that a second price is added from the product's Pricing section using Add price.
We explained that the redirect is set in the product's Pages settings, under the After purchase redirect option.
We explained that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer.
customer_next_steps.timeline: that week (the week of our call)

support_next_steps.text: We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
